capabilities: Open and edit CSV/TSV files in a table view
Run SQLite queries over CSV data
Export auto-updating bar, line and heatmap charts
Insert Markdown tables and single-cell query values into notes
Edit JSON with syntax highlighting and compact saving
extras: Desktop only (Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64); mobile users are pointed to a separate csvzall Lite app. The bundled C++ helper is verified with SHA-256 and extracted into the plugin directory, or a custom executable path can be set. Works offline with no telemetry. main.js exceeds 5 MB, so Obsidian Sync Standard cannot sync it; install separately on each desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, edit or query CSV/TSV files, so tabular data has to be handled in another app.

relations.evidence: To use CSV data with Obsidian Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex, choose Enable or repair under Agent integration
